The '''Upper Industrial Sector''' was a district on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] that featured a large number of industrial facilities and factories. Located above the [[Lower Industrial Sector]], the Upper Industrial Sector was connected to the adjacent [[Ternion Building]] by a bridge, and the sector's various sections were arranged around the [[Exchange Factory Square]]. The district served as the center of manufacturing and industry for [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] corporations on Nar Shaddaa, and the sector's construction facilities were [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]] old by the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]].
